purpose: Verify direct preaction interface collection and canonical Hangzhou operation.
implementation_first: Create a separate collector protocol reusing native prefix and movement event accounting; current collector accepts Cologne/Jinan only. Record all focal incoming and outgoing lane measurements at t0.
roster: One fixed internal TLS, one new seed and one 600–660s first-eight-action-eligible state per city; freeze exact roster before any rollout. No outcome-based replacement.
reference: First PP branch is one of each city's eight; no extra smoke rollout.
input_time: Only t0 lane observations, static topology/conflicts, executor state and nominal joint action timelines. Actual future phases are audit outputs only.
operational_pass: All 16 branches have matching native starts and candidate rosters; direct t0 measurements and mapped conflicts complete; event accounting valid; no collisions/teleports; nominal/actual differences documented and explained.
failure: Retain failed fixed case and stop this measurement pilot; do not replace its seed/state.
after_pass: Choose one new model protocol and a separate whole-seed source/target data budget; do not fit on this measurement pilot.
limitations: Two states establish neither dynamic supply coverage nor transfer benefit. Existing HOLD_RESPONSE remains closed; no cost model or closed-loop expansion.
